observations: Registered Number Line entries retain linear input expressions independently of Fix/Sci/Norm; view-window and axis labels use a separate compact numeric format.
FIX and SCI indicators remain visible when enabled.
SETTINGS opens on list rows A/B/C and at the Math Box root. It is ignored on Execute, bounds, plots and View-Window.
Changing the angle unit clears A/B/C; choosing the existing unit and changing number format preserve registrations.
Single-point auto-centering rounds to the scale; plotted endpoints snap to half-tick positions.
